topic: AI in drug discovery – what it is, where we stand and the path forward
headline: AI's Role in Drug Discovery
caption:
As a full stack developer passionate about AI, I find the advancements in AI-driven drug discovery fascinating. It’s exciting to see models predicting molecule behavior and shrinking development timelines. However, building reliable, ethically sound systems remains complex. Data quality and interpretability are critical hurdles I think we need to tackle as an industry. Personally, I see my role in creating robust pipelines that support transparent and validated AI models. The future is promising, but a cautious, collaborative approach will unlock its full potential. 🚀
